_note: The Sunken Abbey, level 8: dark halls and a door to Mirefall. See docs/zones.md.

sa_path.name: The Abbey Path
sa_path.description: A path along the sea cliffs to a half-drowned abbey.

sa_gate.name: The Gatehouse
sa_gate.description: The abbey's gatehouse, still dry. A lamp burns for travellers. Brother Aldous lives here.

sa_cloister.name: The Cloister
sa_cloister.description: A ruined cloister. The sea comes in at high tide; seaweed hangs from the arches.

sa_garden.name: The Drowned Garden
sa_garden.description: The monks' garden, gone to salt and kelp.

sa_study.name: The Abbot's Study
sa_study.description: A study at the top of a broken stair, books swollen with damp. The Abbot never left.

features.desk: A ledger lies open, as if he just stepped away.

sa_nave.name: The Flooded Nave
sa_nave.description: Knee-deep black water in a vast nave. Things move in it.

sa_belfry.name: The Sunken Belfry
sa_belfry.description: The bell tower, fallen in. The great bell lies half in the water.

features.bell: Saint Hesk's bell. Cracked, but it would ring.

sa_undercroft.name: The Undercroft
sa_undercroft.description: A vaulted crypt under the nave. In the middle, a stone font fills and empties with no tide.

features.font: The water in it reflects a grey sky that isn't this one. When it rains outside, it stirs.

abbots_ledger.name: Abbot's ledger
abbots_ledger.description: A water-stained ledger. The last page is a list of names.

bell_mallet.name: bell mallet
bell_mallet.description: A heavy wooden mallet, made for one bell.

aldous.name: Brother Aldous
aldous.label: Monk
aldous.description: an old monk with salt-white hair
aldous.details: An old monk with salt-white hair.

topics.work: My brothers drowned, and won't lie still. Ask me about the brothers, the ledger, or the bell.

brothers.text: Six of them walk the cloister and the nave. Put them to rest. Their dirge can't be blocked; step away from it.

ledger.text: The Abbot's ledger is in his study. So is the Abbot. His wail kills the living, and nothing turns it. Creep in, take the ledger, creep out.

bell.text: Ring Saint Hesk's bell, in the drowned belfry. It's said the Font answers. Ask me for the mallet.

topics.mallet: The bell mallet. Mind you don't drop it in the nave.
topics.font: The Font in the undercroft. When it rains, it opens onto Mirefall, they say, where the rain never stops. I've never dared.

lure.sense: {Where}, a lamp burning in a gatehouse window.
lure.rumour: Brother Aldous at the abbey gate needs help with the drowned brothers.

holy_water.perfect_hit: {actor} sprinkles holy water, and it takes.
holy_water.description: From the abbey's last clean font. Heals, and better in the rain.

abbey_habit.name: Abbey Habit
abbey_habit.description: A monk's habit of thick wool, blessed. +1 Focus.

kill.goal: Put six drowned monks to rest, in the cloister and the nave.

back.goal: Tell Aldous: DISCUSS BROTHERS WITH ALDOUS.

get.goal: Creep into the Abbot's Study, past his shade: GET LEDGER.

back.goal: Bring it to Aldous: GIVE LEDGER TO ALDOUS.

effects.text: Aldous reads the names, and nods at each. "Now I can pray for them properly. Take this."

mallet.goal: Ask Aldous for the bell mallet: DISCUSS MALLET WITH ALDOUS.

ring.goal: Ring the sunken bell, in the dark belfry east of the nave: USE MALLET ON BELL.

effects.text: The bell booms under the water. Below you, in the undercroft, something stirs in the Font.

back.goal: Tell Aldous: DISCUSS FONT WITH ALDOUS.

effects.text: "Then it's true. In the rain, the Font opens onto Mirefall. Go if you must. Come back if you can."
